systems.system: Human Resources Information System (HRIS) of the Congolese National Police
systems.owner: Police nationale congolaise, set up by the EU-funded Police Reform Support Program (PARP 3) through Coginta, DCAF and Enabel
systems.tiers: police headquarters and the Kinshasa garrison; the HR departments of the provincial police stations of Tshikapa, Bunia and Mbandaka equipped with IT resources, as of May 2025

note: A personnel system of the national police and its provincial stations: a national agency's field offices, out of scope; no local government office is mentioned.
